name: @peac/monorepo
description: Portable signed records for agent, API, MCP, and cross-runtime interactions.
author: jithinraj <7850727+jithinraj@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.typecheck:apps: pnpm --filter @peac/app-sandbox-issuer typecheck && pnpm --filter @peac/app-verifier typecheck && pnpm --filter @peac/app-api typecheck
scripts.ci:all: pnpm run ci:guards && pnpm run ci:surface && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:unicode && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.demo:all: pnpm --filter @peac/example-hello-world... --filter @peac/example-minimal... --filter @peac/example-mcp-tool-call... --filter @peac/example-mcp-gateway-receipts... --filter @peac/example-gateway-decision-evidence... --filter @peac/example-x402-node-server... --filter @peac/example-managed-agents-export... --filter @peac/example-commerce-evidence-bundle... --filter @peac/example-mpp-payment-record... build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-hello-world demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-minimal demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-mcp-tool-call demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-mcp-gateway-receipts demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-gateway-decision-evidence demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-x402-node-server demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-managed-agents-export demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-commerce-evidence-bundle demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-mpp-payment-record demo
scripts.verify:examples-commerce: pnpm --filter @peac/example-paymentauth-evidence build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-paymentauth-jsonrpc build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-acp-session-lifecycle build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-stripe-spt-evidence build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-commerce-evidence-bundle build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-x402-dual-header-read build && pnpm --filter @peac/example-paymentauth-evidence demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-paymentauth-jsonrpc demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-acp-session-lifecycle demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-stripe-spt-evidence demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-commerce-evidence-bundle demo && pnpm --filter @peac/example-x402-dual-header-read demo
scripts.bench: pnpm --filter @peac/crypto bench && pnpm --filter @peac/schema bench && pnpm --filter @peac/protocol bench
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter @peac/app-sandbox-issuer build && pnpm --filter @peac/app-verifier build && pnpm --filter @peac/app-api build
scripts.test:apps: pnpm --filter @peac/app-sandbox-issuer test && pnpm --filter @peac/app-verifier test && pnpm --filter @peac/app-api test

overridesComments.minimatch: Cross-major pin to 10.2.4: typescript-estree requires ^9.0.4 but 9.x has no patch for GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26. minimatch 10.x is API-compatible (same globbing interface). 10.2.4 patches GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj and GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74 (ReDoS). Drops Node 18 (fine: repo baseline is >=22.0.0). Lint verified clean.
overridesComments.picomatch: Override to >=4.0.4: patches GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj (ReDoS via extglob quantifiers). Dev-only via vitest/vite/dependency-cruiser.
overridesComments.qs@>=6.7.0 <6.16.1: Range-scoped to qs 6.x from 6.7.0 and pinned to the patched 6.16.1. Fixes GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx and GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g and keeps the earlier GHSA-w7fw-mjwx-w883 and GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26 fixes. Production path: @peac/mcp-server -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express -> qs.
overridesComments.zod: Workspace-wide Zod 4 enforcement at the patched ^4.6.6 (fixes GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5): prevents mixed Zod 3/4 which causes runtime TypeError (incompatible internal _parse API). All workspace packages must use Zod 4.
overridesComments.rollup: Override vulnerable 4.53.2 to >=4.59.0 (fixes GHSA-mw96-cpmx-2vgc path traversal). Dev-only via vitest/vite/tsup.
overridesComments.express-rate-limit: Override 8.2.1 to >=8.2.2 <9 (fixes GHSA-46wh-pxpv-q5gq IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass). Prod dep via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.
overridesComments.flatted: Override to >=3.4.2 (fixes GHSA-25h7-pfq9-p65f unbounded recursion DoS + GHSA-rf6f-7fwh-wjgh prototype pollution via parse()). Dev-only via eslint -> file-entry-cache -> flat-cache.
overridesComments.path-to-regexp@>=8.0.0: Override to >=8.4.0 <9 (fixes GHSA-j3q9-mxjg-w52f sequential optional groups DoS). Prod dep via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express@5 -> router. path-to-regexp@0.1.12 in express@4 (examples only, not published) is not overridden because 0.1.13 breaks express@4 internal API.
overridesComments.protobufjs@>=8.0.0 <8.4.1: Vulnerable 8.x below 8.4.1, pinned to the minimum patched 8.4.1 for GHSA-wcpc-wj8m-hjx6, which also supersedes the earlier 8.0.0..8.0.1 advisories this override previously carried (GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg, GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm, GHSA-75px-5xx7-5xc7, GHSA-jvwf-75h9-cwgg, GHSA-685m-2w69-288q, GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3, GHSA-fx83-v9x8-x52w, GHSA-q6x5-8v7m-xcrf). Reached through examples/telemetry-otel via @opentelemetry/otlp-transformer, which pins protobufjs 8.0.0 exactly, so ordinary resolution cannot select a patched release. Pinned rather than an open floor because that exact upstream pin gives no basis for admitting later 8.x releases.
overridesComments.@protobufjs/utf8: Defensive pin to 1.1.1 (fixes GHSA-q6x5-8v7m-xcrf in @protobufjs/utf8@<=1.1.0). protobufjs@8.0.2 no longer resolves the prior @protobufjs/* subtree in the current lockfile; this override prevents the vulnerable utf8 helper from re-entering through another transitive path. No published runtime package depends on it.
overridesComments.defu: Override to >=6.1.5 (fixes GHSA-737v-mqg7-c878 prototype pollution via __proto__ in defaults argument). Dev-only via wrangler -> @cloudflare/unenv-preset / unenv. Wrangler 3.x bundles defu 6.1.4; Wrangler 4 (latest) is a major bump deferred for separate review.
overridesComments.esbuild@<0.25.0: Range-scoped to <0.25.0 only (forces patched 0.25.0+, fixes GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 dev-server CORS bypass). Dev-only via wrangler / @esbuild-plugins/node-globals-polyfill peer / @esbuild-plugins/node-modules-polyfill peer (all ship esbuild 0.17.19). Newer esbuild instances at 0.25.12+ already pulled by vitest/tsx are unaffected.
overridesComments.undici@<6.29.1: Range-scoped to <6.29.1 and pinned to exact 6.29.1 on the undici v6 line. Fixes GHSA-rfgv-xxqx-mfg5 and GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c and keeps the earlier v6 patches. Prod path: apps/api -> @peac/resolver-http -> @peac/net-node (declares ^6.29.1); dev path: wrangler -> miniflare.
overridesComments.postcss@<8.5.18: Vulnerable at or below 8.5.17, forced to the patched >=8.5.18 <9 for GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 and GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q. Next 15.5.x pins postcss 8.4.31 exactly, so ordinary resolution reintroduces a vulnerable copy. Upper bound <9 prevents an unreviewed major.
overridesComments.form-data@<4.0.6: Range-scoped to <4.0.6 only (forces patched 4.0.6+, fixes GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field/filename). Dev-only via the supertest/superagent HTTP test client used by @peac/middleware-express tests; not in any published package.
overridesComments.vite@<6.4.2: Range-scoped to <6.4.2; forces >=8.1.6 <9 (fixes GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm and keeps the earlier GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583, GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9 and GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff fixes). Dev-only via apps/verifier (internal app); upper bound <9 prevents an unreviewed major.
overridesComments.ws@>=8.0.0 <8.21.0: Range-scoped to the v8 line below 8.21.0 only, pinned to exact 8.21.0 (the fixed v8 release). Fixes CVE-2026-48779 / GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p (memory-exhaustion DoS from tiny fragments/data chunks) by resolving ws v8 to the patched 8.21.0 line. Dev/examples-only: resolves via dev wrangler -> miniflare -> ws and examples/erc8004-feedback -> isows; not in any published package. Exact pin (not a >= bound) keeps the lockfile diff narrow and stays on the v8 line.
overridesComments.hono: Floor 4.13.13 (latest 4.13.x; fixes the hono advisories open against 4.12.25 and keeps the earlier 4.12.25 fixes); upper bound <5 keeps the 4.x line. Prod dep via apps/api, apps/sandbox-issuer, packages/mcp-server and packages/server.
overridesComments.fast-uri@<3.1.6: Range-scoped to vulnerable fast-uri 3.x below 3.1.6. Forces >=3.1.6 <4 so ajv stays on the 3.x line it declares (^3.0.1) and no unreviewed transitive major upgrade can occur. Retains the earlier CVE-2026-6321 (path traversal via percent-encoded dot segments), CVE-2026-6322 (host confusion via percent-encoded authority delimiters), GHSA-v2hh-gcrm-f6hx (host confusion via literal backslash authority, patched 3.1.4) and GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6 (host confusion via failed IDN canonicalization, patched 3.1.3) fixes, and adds the patched floor 3.1.6 for four advisories disclosed 2026-09: GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8 (host confusion via skipped IDN canonicalization on scheme-relative references), GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc (SSRF via malformed IPv6 normalization), GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf (SSRF via repeated hostname percent-decoding), and GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp (host confusion via percent-encoded scheme normalization). Transitive dependency via ajv / ajv-formats: reached as a devDependency of the root and of @peac/protocol (test-helper schema validation only, excluded from the published build output and package files), and as a declared production dependency of the private, unpublished @peac/receipts package and apps/api. No published npm package (scripts/publish-manifest.json, 36 packages) carries fast-uri in its shipped runtime dependency graph. Lockfile resolves fast-uri 3.x to 3.1.6; ajv is unchanged at 8.18.0.
overridesComments.browserslist@<4.28.7: Range-scoped to vulnerable browserslist below 4.28.7, forces the patched 4.28.7 floor for two advisories disclosed 2026-09: GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx (unbounded memory growth / no cache eviction via distinct query results, leading to eventual OOM) and GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g (uncaught crash / prototype write via untrusted browserslist-stats.json custom stats in normalizeStats). Dev-only: reached via ts-jest / babel-jest -> @babel/core -> @babel/helper-compilation-targets -> browserslist -> update-browserslist-db, and via apps/api's jest/@jest/transform chain. Not in any published package's runtime dependency graph.
overridesComments.ip-address@>=10.0.0 <10.7.4: Range-scoped to ip-address 10.x below 10.7.4 and pinned to the patched 10.7.4. Fixes GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5, GHSA-j6r3-76f7-8jcv, GHSA-h3mg-xc3c-68pw, GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q and GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc, and keeps the earlier CVE-2026-42338 and GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr fixes. Transitive prod dep via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express-rate-limit.
overridesComments.js-yaml@>=4.0.0 <4.3.2: Range-scoped to the v4 line below 4.3.2; forces >=4.3.2 <5 (fixes GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh and keeps the earlier GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m fix). Dev-only: root devDependency used by repo tooling; not in any published package.
overridesComments.js-yaml@>=3.0.0 <3.15.2: Range-scoped to the v3 line below 3.15.2; forces >=3.15.2 <4 (fixes GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh and keeps the earlier GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m fix). Dev/test-only via apps/api -> jest -> babel-plugin-istanbul; not in any published package.
overridesComments.sharp@<0.35.5: Forces sharp below 0.35.5 to the patched >=0.35.5 <0.36 (fixes GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c and GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w). Optional dependency of Next 15.5.x and Wrangler 3.114.x; dev-only. Upper bound <0.36 avoids unreviewed native releases.
overridesComments.nanoid@<3.3.17: Range-scoped to the nanoid 3.x line below 3.3.17 only (forces >=3.3.17 <4). Fixes GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 / CVE-2026-67213 (custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero, a DoS in nanoid's custom-alphabet API). Dev-only via vitest / @vitest/coverage-v8 -> vite -> postcss, which declares ^3.3.16; not in any published package. Same-major patch bump (resolves to 3.3.18) preserves the nanoid 3.x API; upper bound <4 prevents an unreviewed major.
overridesComments.@hono/node-server: Floor 1.19.15 (fixes GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9); upper bound <2 keeps the 1.x line. Prod dep via apps/api, apps/sandbox-issuer and packages/server.
overridesComments.@opentelemetry/core@>=2.0.0 <2.8.0: Range-scoped to the 2.x line below 2.8.0; forces >=2.8.0 <3 (fixes GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf). Upper bound <3 keeps the 2.x line. Reached via examples/telemetry-otel.

overridesComments.body-parser@<1.20.9: Range-scoped to body-parser 1.x below 1.20.9; forces >=1.20.9 <2 (fixes GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 and GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6). Examples only, via express 4.
overridesComments.handlebars@>=4.0.0 <4.7.10: Range-scoped to handlebars 4.x below 4.7.10 and pinned to the patched 4.7.10 (fixes GHSA-8r5x-fm3f-whwj and GHSA-p8wg-vrv2-v86f). Dev-only via apps/api -> ts-jest; not in any published package.
overridesComments.brace-expansion@>=5.0.0 <5.0.11: Range-scoped to brace-expansion 5.x below 5.0.11; forces >=5.0.11 <6 (fixes GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 and GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p). Dev-only via eslint -> minimatch.
overridesComments.source-map-js@<1.2.2: Forces source-map-js below 1.2.2 to >=1.2.2 <2 (fixes GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q). Dev-only via @vitest/coverage-v8 and postcss.
